body: The wrap sits flat against the body without pulling at the chest, which is rare for me since I'm on the smaller side up top. Burgundy is deep and rich, not the orange-red some photos make wrap dresses look like. Sleeves are long enough to cover my wrists too.

This is genuinely one of the comfiest dresses I own, feels like wearing a sweatshirt but looks put together. Only thing is the tie sits a little higher than my natural waist so I adjusted it lower for a better silhouette. Fabric hasn't pilled after three washes.

Wasn't sure about ordering a wrap dress online since fit is so particular but this one worked out. The jersey has good stretch without feeling cheap, and the V-neck isn't as deep as it looked in the photos so it's actually office appropriate.

The dress looks great standing up but when I sit down the wrap front tends to shift and gap slightly at the chest, so I've started wearing a cami underneath just in case. Fabric quality is nice and soft, length is right at the knee which I like. It's fine, just not as secure as I'd hoped for something I want to wear all day.
Long sleeves make this actually wearable into cooler months instead of just summer. Jersey is soft against skin, no itch at all. Runs slightly large in my opinion so I'd size down if unsure.
Comfy, good color, would order again.

Picked the M based on her usual size in similar brands and it fit her well through the shoulders and waist. She mentioned the fabric is a little thinner than she expected but says it drapes nicely regardless and she's already worn it twice this month.

I can go straight from the office to dinner in this without changing, which is exactly what I wanted. The midi length is modest enough for meetings and the wrap tie can be adjusted throughout the day if it loosens.

After being packed for shipping it took a full day hanging up before the wrinkles relaxed, and it still creases a bit after sitting in a car seat. Fit itself is true to size and the color matches the listing well. Just wish the jersey held its shape a little better.

I own two other wrap dresses and this is now my favorite of the three. The sleeve length is just right, not too tight at the wrist, and the fabric moves with you instead of clinging. Only very minor note is the tie strings are a touch short if you want a bigger bow, but I just wrap it twice around.

love the color and the fit is spot on for my usual size but under strong sunlight you can see the outline of a slip underneath, worth knowing before you wear it out. otherwise soft and comfortable all day, no complaints on the stretch or the length
Soft, fits true to size, no issues so far.

The tie at the waist does not hold well and loosened twice within the first hour of wearing it out, which was pretty embarrassing honestly. Fabric feels fine and the burgundy color is nice, but a wrap dress needs to actually stay wrapped. Might try a smaller size next time to see if that helps, but returning this one for now.

The V-neck and wrap style look polished on camera without being fussy to put on. I appreciate that the sleeves are genuinely long sleeve length and not the cropped kind that shows up in some listings. Washed it on cold and it kept its shape fine.

dress is nice, no real complaints there, the jersey feels good and true to size for me. only annoying part was it arrived like four days past the estimate so i almost missed wearing it for the event i bought it for. glad it worked out in the end 🙂

This dress does a lot of work for how simple it is. The wrap silhouette is flattering without needing shapewear underneath, and the burgundy reads as sophisticated rather than flashy. I wore it to a friend's engagement dinner and felt properly dressed without being uncomfortable all night. Small thing worth noting, the fabric picked up a tiny bit of lint from my coat on the drive over, easy enough to brush off but I wasn't expecting jersey to attract it that much.
